```{r eval = F}
library(reticulate)

possible_conda <- c(
  file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), "anaconda3", "Scripts", "conda.exe"),
  file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), "miniconda3", "Scripts", "conda.exe"),

  "C:/ProgramData/miniconda3/Scripts/conda.exe"
)

conda <- possible_conda[file.exists(possible_conda)][1]

if (is.na(conda)) {
  stop("Could not find conda.exe. Check where Anaconda/Miniconda is installed.")
}

python <- file.path(dirname(dirname(conda)), "python.exe")

Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_PYTHON = python)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_install("numpy")

np <- import("numpy", convert = FALSE)

# Function to load .npy, convert to CSV, and handle allow_pickle if needed

load_npy_to_csv <- function(npy_path, csv_path) {

  py_data <- np$load(npy_path, allow_pickle = TRUE)
  
  shp <- py_to_r(py_data$shape)
  
  print(paste("Shape of data:", paste(shp, collapse = " x ")))

  r_list <- py_to_r(py_data$tolist())

  data_matrix <- do.call(rbind, r_list)

  data_df <- as.data.frame(data_matrix)

  colnames(data_df) <- 1:ncol(data_df)  # Event columns

  print(dim(data_df))

  write.csv(data_df, file = csv_path, row.names = TRUE)

  print(paste("Successfully converted", npy_path, "to", csv_path))

}
```

# Decoded arousal
```{r}
reshape_decoded_long <- function(csv_path, value_name, expected_subjects, expected_events) {
  wide_df <- read.csv(csv_path, row.names = 1)  # Use row.names=1 to handle the row names properly
  
  # Check if we have the right number of subjects
  if(nrow(wide_df) != length(expected_subjects)) {
    warning(paste("Expected", length(expected_subjects), "subjects but found", nrow(wide_df), "in", csv_path))
  }
  
  # Add subject IDs as first column
  wide_df$subj <- expected_subjects[1:nrow(wide_df)]  # Use only as many subjects as we have rows
  
  # Reshape to long format
  long_df <- wide_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -subj, names_to = "events", values_to = value_name) %>%
    mutate(events = parse_number(events),  # Extract event numbers from column names
           events = as.factor(events),
           subj = as.factor(subj))
  
  # For Sherlock: the original CSV columns should correspond to actual event numbers (2-27, 29-50)
  # We need to map the CSV column positions to the correct event numbers
  if(length(expected_events) == 48) {  # This is Sherlock data
    # The CSV has 48 columns that correspond to events 2-27, 29-50
    # We need to recode the column numbers to actual event numbers
    long_df <- long_df %>%
      mutate(events = case_when(
        as.numeric(as.character(events)) <= 26 ~ as.numeric(as.character(events)) + 1,  # Columns 1-26 -> Events 2-27
        as.numeric(as.character(events)) >= 27 ~ as.numeric(as.character(events)) + 2   # Columns 27-48 -> Events 29-50
      )) %>%
      mutate(events = as.factor(events))
  }
  
  return(long_df)
}

# Define subject lists
ff_subjects <- c(1, 2, 7:14, 16:20)  # 15 subjects （1-20 excluding 3,4,5,6,15)

# Sherlock events are numbered 2-27, 29-50 (not 1-48!)

sherlock_events <- c(2:27, 29:50)  # Actual event numbers: 2,3,4,...,27,29,30,...,50

# Handle special case for subject 5 in Sherlock (missing events 49,50)
# This should remove exactly 2 rows to get from 672 to 670
kill_keys <- tibble(
  subj   = as.character(5 + 100),
  events = as.character(c(49, 50) + 100)
)

fix_drop <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      subj   = as.character(subj),
      events = as.character(events)
    ) %>%
    anti_join(kill_keys, by = c("subj","events")) %>%
    mutate(
      subj   = factor(subj),
      events = factor(events)
    )
}

decoded_sherlock_pupil_long    <- fix_drop(decoded_sherlock_pupil_long)
decoded_sherlock_paranoia_long <- fix_drop(decoded_sherlock_paranoia_long)
decoded_sherlock_ff_long    <- fix_drop(decoded_sherlock_ff_long)
decoded_sherlock_eeg_long    <- fix_drop(decoded_sherlock_eeg_long)

cat("Sherlock arousal from pupil data after filtering:", nrow(decoded_sherlock_pupil_long), "rows\n")
cat("Sherlock arousal from paranoia data after filtering:", nrow(decoded_sherlock_paranoia_long), "rows\n")
cat("Sherlock arousal from movie data after filtering:", nrow(decoded_sherlock_ff_long), "rows\n")
cat("Sherlock arousal from eeg data after filtering:", nrow(decoded_sherlock_eeg_long), "rows\n")
```

```{r}
# ---- helpers ----
zscore <- function(x) {(x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)}
sem <- function(x) {sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(length(x))}
```

# Combine data
```{r}
# ---------- columns to keep ----------
num_cols <- c(
  "recall_accuracy", "PC_movie_avg", "Eg_movie",
  "decoded_arousal_pupil",              # from pupil
  "decoded_arousal_paranoia",           # from paranoia
  "decoded_arousal_movie",              # from movies
  "decoded_arousal_eeg"
)

join_decoded <- function(base_df, decoded_list) {
  Reduce(function(x, y) inner_join(x, y, by = c("subj", "events")),
         decoded_list, init = base_df)
}

# ---------- FilmFest ----------
df_ff <- join_decoded(
  df_filmfest_216,
  list(
    decoded_ff_pupil_long,              # decoded_arousal_pupil
    decoded_ff_paranoia_long,           # decoded_arousal_paranoia
    decoded_ff_sherlock_long,           # decoded_arousal_movie
    decoded_ff_eeg_long                 # decoded_arousal_eeg
  )
) %>%
  select(subj, events, event_duration, all_of(num_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_cols), zscore))%>%
  mutate(dataset = 1)
  
# ---------- Sherlock ----------
df_sr <- join_decoded(
  df_sherlock_216,
  list(
    decoded_sherlock_pupil_long,        # decoded_arousal_pupil
    decoded_sherlock_paranoia_long,     # decoded_arousal_paranoia
    decoded_sherlock_ff_long,           # decoded_arousal_movie
    decoded_sherlock_eeg_long           # decoded_arousal_eeg

  )
) %>%
  select(subj, events, event_duration, all_of(num_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_cols), zscore))%>%
  mutate(dataset = 2)

# ---------- Stack & factor ----------
df_stacked <- bind_rows(df_ff, df_sr) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset))
d1 <- df_stacked
d1$subj   <- as.factor(d1$subj)
d1$events <- as.factor(d1$events)

# ---------- sanity checks ----------
cat("FF data dimensions:", nrow(df_ff), "rows\n")
cat("Sherlock data dimensions:", nrow(df_sr), "rows\n")
cat("Combined data dimensions:", nrow(d1), "rows\n")
cat("\n---EXPECTATIONS54---\n")
cat("Expected FF rows: 15 subjects × 68 events =", 15*68, "\n")
cat("Expected Sherlock rows: 13 subjects × 48 events + 1 subject × 46 events =", 13*48 + 1*46, "\n")
cat("Expected total d1 rows:", 15*68 + 13*48 + 1*46, "\n")

write.csv(d1, "../4_results/4_recall/decoded_arousal_combined.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# You may need to install Rtools 4.5 for this part from https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/.

# --- Run for pupil ---
fit_brms_recall_arousal_pupil <- brm(
  recall_accuracy ~ decoded_arousal_pupil + (1 | subj) + (1 | dataset),
  data = df_arousal,
  prior = prior,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, seed = 123,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
)

post_brms_recall_arousal_pupil <- as_draws_df(fit_brms_recall_arousal_pupil)$b_decoded_arousal_pupil
b_brms_recall_arousal_pupil <- mean(post_brms_recall_arousal_pupil)
hdi_brms_recall_arousal_pupil <- hdi(post_brms_recall_arousal_pupil, ci = 0.95, method = "HDI")
gt_0_brms_recall_arousal_pupil <- sum(post_brms_recall_arousal_pupil > 0) / length(post_brms_recall_arousal_pupil)

cat("\n--- brms: Recall Fidelity ~ Decoded Arousal (Pupil, Pooled Data) ---\n")
cat(paste0("Posterior Mean (decoded_arousal_pupil): ", round(b_brms_recall_arousal_pupil, 3), "\n"))
cat(paste0("95% HDI: [", round(hdi_brms_recall_arousal_pupil$CI_low, 3), ", ", round(hdi_brms_recall_arousal_pupil$CI_high, 3), "]\n"))
cat(paste0("Probability (b > 0): ", round(gt_0_brms_recall_arousal_pupil, 3), "\n"))
```

```{r}
# ====== Save posterior results for plotting ======


save_post <- function(prefix, draws, hdi_obj, p_gt0) {
  out <- list(
    draws  = as.numeric(draws),
    hdi    = data.frame(low = hdi_obj$CI_low, high = hdi_obj$CI_high),
    mean   = mean(draws),
    median = median(draws),
    p_gt0  = as.numeric(p_gt0)
  )
  saveRDS(out, file = file.path("../4_results/4_recall", paste0(prefix, ".rds")))
}

# ---- Recall ~ Decoded Arousal ----
# pupil
save_post("recall_pupil",   post_brms_recall_arousal_pupil,   hdi_brms_recall_arousal_pupil,   gt_0_brms_recall_arousal_pupil)
# paranoia
save_post("recall_paranoia", post_brms_recall_arousal_paranoia, hdi_brms_recall_arousal_paranoia, gt_0_brms_recall_arousal_paranoia)
# movie
save_post("recall_movie", post_brms_recall_arousal_movie, hdi_brms_recall_arousal_movie, gt_0_brms_recall_arousal_movie)
# eeg
save_post("recall_eeg", post_brms_recall_arousal_eeg, hdi_brms_recall_arousal_eeg, gt_0_brms_recall_arousal_eeg)


cat("Saved posterior summaries.")
```
